naturalism_issues: Event photographer donor-glass coverage produces exactly the required sequence of wrapped glass, place setting, collection and pour. Unless this coverage assignment is explained, the evidentiary precision feels engineered.

The record says kept it through the 6:46 pour and toast while previous private-service and press clues schedule the toast at 6:49. This may mean custody through a later toast, but the wording is ambiguous.
An unattended special glass amid circulating guests is plausible service behavior; leaving the salon camera off adds convenience to the puzzle.
Antique cyanide potency and the negligent bottle return remain unexplained.
Earlier repetitive motive monologues remain a naturalism concern; this release introduces no speaker self-identification giveaway.
